request: Add structured mobile logging with react-native-logs, Sentry error/ANR reporting, crash-gated unmasked mobile session replay, and in-app diagnostic sharing without changing product behavior.
acceptance: Application events are normalized through one client logger with bounded local retention and full diagnostic payloads during the temporary office monitoring period.
Sentry receives actionable errors, breadcrumbs, crash context, and ANR context; ordinary sessions do not upload replay.
Crash or application-not-responding events can upload the preceding mobile replay buffer when supported by the installed Sentry native SDK.
Users can share a recent diagnostic report from Settings without accessing application directories.
Task creation emits correlated start, duplicate-tap, SQLite, success, navigation, and failure events without task content.
Logging or telemetry failures cannot change or block application behavior.
excluded: Remote application logging API or backend service; this app remains local-only.
Uploading the local SQLite database file itself.
Changes to existing task, list, WhatsApp, SQLite schema, or navigation behavior.
verification: Run workspace platform checks and app reference scan.
Build the Android release artifact when the local build environment is available.
Verify full diagnostic payloads and bounded local log behavior in a release-like build.
Manually exercise task creation, repeated taps, failure handling, Settings diagnostic sharing, and Sentry crash/replay delivery.
rollback: Revert this local Git change and reinstall the prior mobile build; the SQLite schema and existing application data are unchanged.
